notes: North is up. Names printed without a suffix are written with 'Street' (LEDIE, JOHNSON). Spring Grove Av. runs down the right edge; only its west line and two water pipes are drawn (the east side is lost in the binding), so the Spring Grove points use the west line + ~52 ft (between the half-width and the pipe midline, which agree within ~20 px). Ledie continues east of Spring Grove as Sassafras (key map), so Ledie/Spring Grove is marked cross; Alabama continues east (sheet 303), cross. Johnson (50') crosses Ledie and runs north off the drawn area; it ends at Alabama (T). Johnson is qualified '(north of Alabama)' to keep it apart from the separate, offset Johnson piece south of Stock Av. (sheets 303, 304). Ledie and Alabama run west to the drawn edge across the railroad; no other streets on the sheet.
